sloka: तत्तत्प्रदद्या वैदेह्या यत्रास्य रमते मनः ।गच्चतोस्तु तयोर्मध्ये बभूव जनकात्मजा ॥२-५५-२९॥
transliteration: tattatpradadyā vaidehyā yatrāsya ramate manaḥ ।gaccatostu tayormadhye babhūva janakātmajā ॥2-55-29॥

translations.english: The daughter of Janaka walked between them like a sheelephant between two males.
